newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan Auto to list B shares on Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: Changan Auto to list B shares on Nov 8.

text.p: Sichuan-based Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd will list 250 million B shares on the Shenzhen bourse on November 8, an official at Shanghai Guotai Securities said on Tuesday.
Guotai is chief domestic underwriter for the offer and Changan's listing promoter.

The official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that Suzuki Motor Co had bought 125 million B shares or 50 percent of Changan's B stock at a price equivalent to 2.96 yuan per share and pledged to hold the 125 million B shares for at least three years.
Changan announced the sale to Suzuki on Sept 27.
The offer of the remaining 125 million B shares, launched at HK$1.89 per share and completed earlier this month, was six times subscribed, the official added.
Before the B share offer, Changan had total share capital of 506.19 million state shares.
